questions.stem: What is the term used to describe two triangles that have exactly the same shape and size?
questions.solution: Congruent is the term used to describe two triangles that have exactly the same shape and size. Similar triangles have the same shape but not necessarily the same size. Identical and equivalent are not specific terms used for triangles in geometry.

questions.stem: If two triangles are congruent, which of the following is true?
choices: Both corresponding sides and angles are equal
questions.solution: If two triangles are congruent, both corresponding sides and angles are equal. This is because congruence means the triangles are identical in shape and size, which includes all corresponding parts. Only sides or only angles being equal would not guarantee congruence.

hi.stem: यदि दो त्रिभुज सर्वांगसम हैं, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सत्य है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a test for congruence of triangles?
questions.solution: The correct answer is SSS. The SSS test states that if three sides of one triangle are congruent to three sides of another triangle, then the triangles are congruent. SSA is not a valid test for congruence, AAA only proves similarity, and SAA is another name for ASA, which is a valid test but not the one being asked here.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा त्रिभुजों के अनुलोमन का परीक्षण है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर SSS है। SSS परीक्षण कहता है कि यदि एक त्रिभुज की तीन भुजाएं दूसरे त्रिभुज की तीन भुजाओं के अनुलोमी होती हैं, तो त्रिभुज अनुलोमी होते हैं। SSA अनुलोमन का वैध परीक्षण नहीं है, AAA केवल समरूपता साबित करता है, और SAA ASA का एक अन्य नाम है, जो एक वैध परीक्षण है लेकिन यहां पूछे गए परीक्षण के बराबर नहीं है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and terminology. All technical terms like 'अनुलोमन' (congruence), 'समरूपता' (similarity), and the test names (SSA, AAA, SAA, SSS) are appropriately used and match standard Hindi textbook terminology.

questions.stem: If two triangles are congruent, what can be said about their corresponding angles?
questions.solution: The correct answer is They are congruent. If two triangles are congruent, their corresponding angles are congruent because congruence implies that all corresponding parts (angles and sides) are equal in measure. The other options are incorrect because congruent triangles do not have supplementary or complementary angles, and they are not non-congruent.

questions.stem: In the given figure, if AB = PQ, BC = QR, and AC = PR, which congruence test can be used to prove that the triangles are congruent?
questions.solution: The SSS (Side-Side-Side) congruence test states that if all three sides of one triangle are equal to the corresponding sides of another triangle, then the triangles are congruent. In this case, all three sides of triangle ABC are equal to the corresponding sides of triangle PQR, so the SSS test applies.

questions.stem: In a right-angled triangle, if the hypotenuse and one side are congruent to the hypotenuse and one side of another right-angled triangle, which test is used to prove congruence?
